correctness.rationale: For each fixed seed set the final activation law equals independent undirected bond-component union. Every three-node curvature is computed exactly over all bond states, and an independent directed-arc exploration check reproduces the distributions. On any star the law of total variance conditioned on center activation yields F_m(k) and exact symbolic factorization of the final-two-leaves discrete second difference. Strict monotonicity of the cubic up to 1/3 and its sign thereafter determines the unique threshold; the logarithmic floor and rare-p limit follow analytically. Reproducible finite computations check but do not replace the infinite-size argument.

value.rationale: Seed-selection submodularity is the foundational guarantee behind classical expected-influence greedy optimization. The result determines exactly when its natural second-moment analogue fails on the smallest connected networks, then constructs a quantified obstruction at every transmission rate by increasing a star. The exact low-p leaf-count scale makes the all-network failure structural and quantitatively motivated rather than a routine small counterexample. It makes no unsupported algorithmic-approximation claims.
